regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, keywords, and SI link
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate Rh-catalyzed C2 allylation claim. Although online Supporting Information is advertised, workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
The SN2'-type/direct C2 allylation drawings summarize cited prior approaches and are classified as literature context rather than current-paper experiments.

The common versus reversed allene-insertion drawings are generic mechanistic possibilities; the bottom arrow is the current general reaction class. Intermediates Int 1-1 to Int 1-6 are not isolated records.
The 1a/1b failures and 1c/1d successes map to Table 1 entries 1-4 on page 2; regioisomer 4 is reported not detected for the successful model reactions, so no narrative duplicates were created.

unresolved: Scheme 1 uses generic R/DG/X/M labels and does not define unique structures or yields.

regions.region: page 2 left Table 1 header, reaction drawing, catalysts, entries 1-18, and footnotes
regions.finding: Eighteen independent optimization rows were retained with shared and overridden catalysts/additives/solvents, 24 h/room-temperature/Ar conditions from the drawing, NMR recoveries, numeric or bounded yields, dashes, failures, entry-3 isolated yield, and entry-15's product label without a numeric yield.

regions.region: page 2 right Table 2 header and twenty product structures
regions.finding: Twenty distinct scope experiments were retained with shared 1 mmol/1.1 equiv/catalyst/additive/5 mL toluene/room-temperature/24 h conditions and superscript overrides for 12 h, 8 h, 50 °C, or 70 °C. Product-specific isolated yields were linked separately.

regions.region: page 2 Table 2 footnotes and 3na side product
regions.finding: Footnote f reports 9% 3na' in addition to 57% 3na. The side product is represented separately but remains label-only because its structure is referred to unassociated SI.
Narrative solvent/catalyst effects and substituent tolerance map to the row records and were not duplicated. X-ray discussion is source characterization, not machine structure verification.

unresolved: Most table rows omit atmosphere/workup/purification/product mass or analytical bases.
Entry 15 lacks a numeric NMR yield.
3na' structure is only referred to SI; no SI association was inferred.

regions.finding: Nine distinct allene trials (including one failure) and one downstream derivatization were retained with source yields, ee values, combined Z/E ratios, and explicit reagent footnotes. The 71% downstream value remains an overall multi-operation yield.
Four separate trials were retained: 2y gives 3dy (74%); 2z and 2x give no desired product; pyrrole 1o gives 3oa (83%). Each retains its displayed scale, allene equivalents, time, and 5 mL toluene.

The gram-scale run, eight bioactive-derived-allene allylations, and six product transformations continue as Scheme 4 on page 4 and are represented with cross-page evidence rather than narrative duplicates.
Nine distinct isotope/KIE/C7-control experiments are introduced and shown on page 4. Approximate and position-specific D incorporation, KIE values, failures, and recovery are retained separately.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits scale, time, workup, purification, masses, and analytical bases for ee/Z:E.
Several mechanistic controls print yields without stating isolated/NMR basis.

regions.finding: A distinct 3.0 mmol 1h/2o run uses 15 mL toluene, room temperature/12 h and gives 1.25 g 3ho in 91% isolated yield.

Eight distinct bioactive-derived-allene standard-condition reactions were retained (3dp-3dB) with individual isolated yields and printed dr/Z-selectivity. Generic ATA/esterification preparation is not assigned the final allylation yield.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Scheme 4c and footnotes i-xi
regions.finding: Six independent transformations were retained. Every explicit footnote reagent/loading/solvent is a participant; temperature/time are paired where printed. The 67% value for (R)-Z-16 remains an overall two-step yield from (R)-3dm.

Nine independent mechanistic experiments were retained with exact displayed scales, equivalents, solvent volumes, isotope purities/incorporations, NMR yields/recoveries, KIE results, prolonged reaction, and non-detection/recovery outcomes.
The standard-condition 1d/2a analytical experiment is represented once; its two detected ions continue in Figure 1 on page 5.

unresolved: Scheme 4 omits many absolute scales, operational workups, and isolated masses.
Several Scheme 5 printed yields lack an explicit measurement basis.
KIE equations 5/6 do not repeat the full standard-condition temperature/atmosphere.

regions.finding: Signals m/z 432 and 710 are linked to detected MS-Int-1 and MS-Int-2 in one analytical experiment; they are not isolated synthetic products. The cited SI MS/MS figure was not imported.

regions.region: page 5 left Scheme 6 and mechanism text
regions.finding: CMD C-H cleavage, regioselective syn-insertion, competing Int 2-2/Int 2-3, protonation, and catalyst release are classified as one proposed mechanism rather than preparations of intermediates.
The page advertises an SI PDF and CIF files, but workspace mapping leaves SI association unestablished; no SI experimental or spectral facts were imported.
Reproduction statements for 3la, Z-3dk, and (R)-Z-3dn were attached as provenance to existing records; no independent run conditions or outcomes are supplied, so no duplicates were created.

unresolved: The cited SI and CIF files are not explicitly associated workspace sources.
SAESI sampling details and full MS/MS evidence are absent from the inspected pages.
Reproduction acknowledgments do not identify separable runs.

regions.finding: Bibliography, reviews, prior examples, preparation citations, and method citations only. External papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article, and no new current-paper reaction operation or outcome appears.

unresolved: No current-paper reaction record is supported solely by page 6.
Prior literature was not imported beyond the generic literature context already classified on page 1.
